name: mobility_advantage
description: Side to move has more legal moves available than the opponent.
source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'mobility_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has more legal moves available than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    
    stm_moves = len(list(board.legal_moves))
    
    board_copy = board.copy()
    board_copy.turn = not stm
    opp_moves = len(list(board_copy.legal_moves))
    
    return stm_moves > opp_moves
